prompt: I have an Angular 21 component with a signal-based dropdown. The available options come from an API (fetched via resource), and the user can select one. When the options list changes (e.g., user switches category), I want to keep the user's selection if it's still in the new list, otherwise reset to the first option. Also, I need a computed signal that shows a formatted display string based on the selection. Can you show me how to wire this up with proper signal equality to avoid unnecessary rerenders?

assertions.text: Uses resource() to fetch dropdown options based on category signal
Uses linkedSignal with object syntax (source + computation + previous) to preserve valid selection
Uses computed() for derived display string
Uses custom equality function ({equal: fn}) on at least one signal
Does NOT use effect() to sync selection state
